mapper.select:
select ca.SEQNO seqno, ca.ASSETPOOL_NAME assetpoolName, cad.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL ca left join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL cad on cad.SEQNO = ca.SEQNO inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = cad.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
and ca.SEQNO = #{seqno}
select SEQNO seqno, ASSETPOOL_NAME assetpoolName from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL where SEQNO = #{seqno}
select distinct SEQNO seqno, ASSETPOOL_NAME assetPoolName, CREATE_TIME, INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL order by CREATE_TIME desc

select fp.FINPROD_ID id, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':'|| fp.FINPROD_NAME text ,fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 from FIN_PRODUCT fp inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ft on fp.FINPROD_ID = ft.FINPROD_ID
and ft.TYPE_8 is not null
and ( fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) or fp.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )

select fp.FINPROD_ID id, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID || ':'|| fp.FINPROD_NAME text from FIN_PRODUCT fp inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ft on fp.FINPROD_ID = ft.FINPROD_ID
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F06','F10','F32') and ft.TYPE_8 is not null
and ( fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) or fp.FINPROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )

select fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 from FIN_PRODUCT fp inner join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE ft on fp.FINPROD_ID = ft.FINPROD_ID
ft.TYPE_8 is not null
and fp.FINPROD_ID in
#{item}

select fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, CRE.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL cad inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = cad.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN CREDIT_ASSETPOOL CRE ON CAD.SEQNO = CRE.SEQNO where cad.SEQNO = #{seqno}
select cad.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL cad left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = cad.FINPROD_ID where cad.SEQNO = #{seqno}
select count(1) from CREDIT_LINES where CREDIT_MST_ID = '0003' and CUSTOMER_ID = #{seqno}

select pm.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId from SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK pm inner join () tempHis on pm.HIS_NO = tempHis.HIS_NO and pm.WORKFLOW_ID = tempHis.WORKFLOW_ID
pm.STATUS = 'A'
and pm.PAGE_ID = #{pageId}
order by pm.create_time desc
